4899-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4899-8266.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer a number of times by exiling all the cards in your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.

1981-2292-2415-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-6097.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

7175-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
7175-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
7175-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

3490-5231-5929-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-5231-5929-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Leyline of Transformation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

224-2157-6763-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Mutavault land token due to Horizon Explorer.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

1722-1912-2034-3000-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-1912-2034-3000-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

2921-4681-5170-6794.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2893-3875-5455-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2341-2495-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2341-2495-4002.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Sceptre of Eternal Glory and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Sceptre of Eternal Glory and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-5220-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
1456-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

700-3862-6331.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-3862-6331.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-3862-6331.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5189-5439-6441.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4050-5189-5439-6441.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4452-4508-6310.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Pirate" chosen.
4452-4508-6310.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
4452-4508-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

2440-4183-4404-4720.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor
2440-4183-4404-4720.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Corridor Monitor for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1849-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

586-2511-5011-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-2511-5011-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

643-647-3742-4251-4344.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
643-647-3742-4251-4344.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
The token Lumbering Battlement enters the battlefield, exiling Godo until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
At the end of your combat phase, the token Lumbering Battlement triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
The token Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

147-1269-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-2292.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

938-944-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control a black or green permanent.
938-944-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard by paying {U}.
Repeat.

1628-2034-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-2034-4186.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1322-2034-2816-4289-5251.notablePrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
1322-2034-2816-4289-5251.description:
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord for {1}.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Use Cryptolith Rite to tap the token creature for {1}.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Umbral Mantle to untap Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
Repeat.

147-1465-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-4050.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

64-2103-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Warden of the Eye.
64-2103-2665.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the token Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

813-1283-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
813-1283-1987-3075.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
